lines.t: Does not conviction bring revelation?
To the hearts where your spirit dwells.
When the fire has done its healing work.
Does it not call us to repentance?
To rise again where righteousness prevails.
Set me free in your love divine.
1 Break these chains that once were mine, in obedience let love be made complete, as I am shedding the skin of this world's deceit.
Crucify the old man, let him fade away
With his sinful ways and fragile pride
Put on the new man, renewed each day
In the knowledge of the Holy One who abides
Set me free in your love divine
Break these chains that once were mine
In obedience let love be made complete
As I'm shedding the skin
Of this world's deceit
Conform into the image of the one who made me whole
Your spirit breathes life into my soul
From conviction to revelation, repentance burns bright
The dawn of grace, the birth of life
Set me free in your endless love
Lift my eyes to the throne above
Let true repentance shape my heart
And from your holiness never depart
For this, my Father, is true repentance
Striving to walk renewed in the image of your Son
guitar solo
We'll see you next time.
